components.name: Status bar
components.description: Status bar — native system clock and indicators for mockups only (the OS renders it in code). Built from the real platform bars — iOS 27 (iPhone 17 Pro, 402 × 62) and Material 3 Android (412 × 52) — painted with BEK static tokens: Content=Dark → static/dark on light screens, Content=Light → static/white on dark screens and media. The nested native instance is exposed — edit Time there. Dynamic Isl

components.name: Home indicator
components.description: Home indicator — native system gesture bar for mockups only. Built from the real platform bars — iOS 27 (402 × 34 safe area, 144 × 5 bar) and Material 3 Android gesture navigation (412 × 24) — painted with BEK static tokens: Content=Dark → static/dark, Content=Light → static/white.
